reviews.author: Rosemary Rhoads
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been a customer of Got Moles for several years. We have the yearly program, which is quite cost effective given the number of moles we have each year in our 1/3 acre lawn. For a flat monthly fee, they service our lawn whenever needed. Their 5 star rating is well deserved. Whenever I see mole activity, they come out within a few days of a call and come back each week until the mole activity ceases. This year has been especially bad for moles, so they have been out every week for months and have caught I'd guess at least 10 moles. The people who have come out are always very nice and responsive to information I provide. They also provide notice both the day before coming out and on the day they are out, the approximate time. If you have a mole problem, I highly recommend Got Moles.
Todd Davis

Highly recommend GotMoles! Robert came out and was very friendly, professional, and took the time to explain everything I had questions about. He was able to catch the mole that had been tearing up our front lawn, and since we have an HOA, getting the problem taken care of quickly was a big deal for me.

Really happy with the service and would definitely recommend Robert and GotMoles to anyone dealing with a mole problem.

reviews.address: 718 Griffin Ave, #905, Enumclaw, WA 98022
reviews.author: Riena T
reviews.text:
Misleading.
I was told about the year long commitment program for $100 a month for a whole year at the initial consultation, but I was also told if I didn't want that, their "one-month quick fix" for $450 would eliminate the moles in my yard. After a month, they only killed one using a trap and the moles returned in 50-ish days (since the tunnel systems are in tact, no pesticides are applied).
I would have liked more clarification at the initial consult that (1) moles are guaranteed to come back after a month of the quick fix since the tunnels aren't touched and pesticides aren't applied so basically moles can come back if they want and (2) that their quick fix is just to place cheap traps over the mounds and that's it.
Not worth the $450 I spent. Didn't want them coming back to my property just to kill another mole I can kill myself. Would not recommend to my friends or family.
